preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 50000 for x in stdin.split() if x.isdigit()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: Input consists of exactly two integers n and k, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 50000 and 0 ≤ 2k ≤ n.

preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and k == int(stdin.split()[1]) and 2*k <= n
preconditions.description: n and k are parsed integers satisfying 2k ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 2*n for x in stdout.split()) and len(stdout.split()) == 2*n
postconditions.description: Output is a permutation of length 2n containing distinct integers from 1 to 2n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.split() == sorted(stdout.split(), key=lambda x: int(x)) or len(set(stdout.split())) == 2*n
postconditions.description: Output is a permutation (all elements distinct and in range 1..2n).

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(int(stdout.split()[2*i-1]) - int(stdout.split()[2*i])) for i in range(1, n+1)) - abs(sum(int(stdout.split()[2*i-1]) - int(stdout.split()[2*i]) for i in range(1, n+1))) == 2*k
postconditions.description: The permutation satisfies the equation: sum of absolute differences of adjacent pairs minus the absolute value of the sum of those differences equals 2k.
